author: Jonathan Robert Pool
description: Tools that test web pages for front-end quality (accessibility, usability, and web standards, including HTML, CSS, ARIA, and WCAG) and make test results available
name: Kilotest

tools.name: getKilotestOverview
tools.description: Explains what Kilotest is, what its tools do, and how its results are structured. Use this before any other tool when the available tools or workflow are unclear. Returns a prose overview of the Kilotest domain, the tool workflow, and links to further documentation. Kilotest integrates an ensemble of 12 rule engines, with about 1,300 rules, to test web pages for front-end quality (accessibility, usability, and web standards, including HTML, CSS, ARIA, and WCAG). Each test session generates a standardized report describing which elements violated which rules and grouping the violations into about 380 issues. Kilotest can list the tested pages, the reports about each page, the issues in each report, the violators of each issue, and the diagnoses of each violation. Kilotest also accepts requests to test pages not yet tested and to retest already tested pages.

tools.name: awaitTest
tools.description: Waits for a job ordered via the orderNewTest or orderRetest tool to finish, using the report identifier either tool returned. Use this instead of polling listIssues when an immediate answer is preferred. Blocks until the report is ready, the job fails, or a maximum wait time elapses, sending no interim notices; returns the finished job’s status and, if ready, its report identifier.

reportID.description: Report identifier returned by orderNewTest or orderRetest (example: 260503T0432-x9z)

report identifier.description: Identifier of the report, to pass to listIssues once the report is ready (example: 260503T0432-x9z).
